message.content: {"hts_code": "3004.90.1090", "reason": "Fosfomycin tromethamine is a retail-packaged oral antibiotic medicament that is neither a penicillin nor streptomycin, so it falls under the antibiotics provision of subheading 3004.90."}
message.reasoning:
Fosfomycin tromethamine is an antibiotic. HTSUS 3004.90 — antibiotics? Actually antibiotics used to be 3004.10 (penicillins) etc. Now heading 3004: 3004.10 penicillins/streptomycins, 3004.20 hormones, 3004.31/32/39 insulin, 3004.40 antibiotics? Let me recall: 3004.90 is "Other" medicaments. There was 3004.20 "Containing antibiotics" — no. Current HTSUS: 3004.10 containing penicillins or streptomycins; 3004.20 containing hormones; 3004.31-39 insulin; 3004.40 containing alkaloids; 3004.50 containing vitamins; 3004.60 containing ephedrine... Actually 3004.90 is other. Fosfomycin is an antibiotic but not penicillin/streptomycin, so 3004.90. Subheading 3004.90.10? There's "3004.90.10 Antibiotics, packaged for retail" — hmm. I recall 3004.90.01? Let me think: HTSUS 3004.90 subdivisions: 3004.90.10 "Antibiotics" ... Actually there is 3004.90.10 "Other: Antibiotics" with duty free? I believe 3004.90.10 is "Antibiotics" and 3004.90.92 "Other". Stat suffixes: 3004.90.1090? Common code cited: 3004.90.0190? Hmm.

HTSUS 3004.90: "Other" — statistical: 3004.90.10 Antibiotics; 3004.90.20 Containing vitamins; 3004.90.30 Containing iron; 3004.90.40 Containing other... Actually I recall 3004.90.92 "Other" with stat suffixes 3004.90.9290. And 3004.90.10 antibiotics stat suffix 3004.90.1090? I think 3004.90.10 has suffixes like 3004.90.1020 etc. Common answer: 3004.90.1090? Hmm, I've seen 3004.90.0130? Let me recall better: Chapter 30 note — antibiotics. In HTSUS, 3004.90.10 "Antibiotics" — statistical breakouts by antibiotic type? I don't think so. I'll answer 3004.90.1090? Risky. Many classification references cite fosfomycin under 3004.90.1090? Actually I recall "3004.90.10 Antibiotics" with stat suffixes 10, 20... e.g., 3004.90.1020? Not sure.

Safer: 3004.90.9290 "Other" — but antibiotics have their own breakout. I believe 3004.90.10 exists for antibiotics. The 10-digit: 3004.90.1090? Hmm, statistical suffixes for 3004.90.10: I think it's just "3004.90.1000"? Some 8-digit subheadings have no further breakout, then suffix "00". Actually 10-digit requires stat suffix; if none, "00". I recall 3004.90.10 has stat breakouts: 3004.90.1010? Uncertain.

I'll go with 3004.90.1090? Let me think of known codes: Amoxicillin often classified 3004.10.5020? No, 3004.10 is penicillins: 3004.10.10, 3004.10.50... For 3004.90: I recall "3004.90.0190" for other medicaments? Hmm. Actually I think the structure is 3004.90.01 "Other" ... no.

Searching memory: HTSUS 3004.90.92 "Other" — duty Free, stat suffixes 9290 etc. And 3004.90.10 "Antibiotics" — I'm fairly confident this exists. Stat suffixes under 3004.90.10: 3004.90.1020? I genuinely recall seeing "3004.90.1090" in customs rulings for antibiotics. Yes, CBP rulings cite 3004.90.1090 for antibiotics packaged for retail? Hmm, I've seen NY rulings citing 3004.90.9290 for various. For antibiotics like fosfomycin, rulings cite 3004.90.1090? I'll go with 3004.90.1090.
